note: Small Gasconade River access with a boat ramp near Fredericksburg. About ten numbered campsites on short gravel spurs off a one-way loop, half on each side of the central ramp parking lot; privy at the lot. --Claude
summary: Confirmed: page 'Boat ramp and individual campsites present', 'Camping: Individual Campsites'; map (06/12) Primitive Camping Area symbols along the loop either side of the parking lot = GIS 10 points; imagery shows each on its own spur off the loop, not on the ramp lot. Free/FCFS/no hookups/14 nights manual. PIN (GIS 82) is on the ramp lot's west edge: move into the west campsite loop 38.60330,-91.63405. Waterfront: riverview lead for sites 149/150 only (unconfirmed, stays down). Phone matches.
flags: INCLUSION/FIT: area page 'Boat ramp and individual campsites present'; 'Along with its boat ramp to the Gasconade River, the Fredericksburg Ferry Access comprises 5 acres of land with primitive camping sites'; 'Camping: Individual Campsites'. Map (06/12): Primitive Camping Area symbols set along the gravel loop on both sides of the Parking Lot, none on the lot. GIS 27 has 10 points; imagery (0.33 m/px) shows 75, 76, 77, 149, 150 on short gravel spurs in the grassy west loop and 78-81 on spurs off the east arm, each a pull-in of ~8-15 m. Designated individual sites, not ramp-lot camping: stays. Spurs look short for a long rig but a 23-ft rig fits most; no length published.
PIN: stored 38.60262,-91.63314 = GIS 82, on the west edge of the central gravel ramp lot (lot 1514). Move into the west campsite loop, which holds most of the sites: 38.60330,-91.63405.

WATERFRONT LEAD (not waterfront kept): the Gasconade is ~100 m wide here (river). Sites 149 and 150 at the loop's north end are ~25-35 m from the bank, but the loop road and a band of riverbank trees lie between; the rest are 50-90 m back. A filtered river view from 149/150 is possible in leaf-off; no MDC photo shows it, so it stays down.
CLUSTERS / NO SPLIT: all 10 points within 170 m on one loop and one entrance.
